title: Product split over a set and its complement
statement: Let $\iota$ be a finite type, let $M$ be a commutative monoid, let $A$ be a subset of $\iota$, and let $f,g:\iota\to M$. The product over all $i\in\iota$ that uses $f(i)$ on $A$ and $g(i)$ outside $A$ equals the product of $f$ over $A$ times the product of $g$ over the complement of $A$.
hypotheses_covered: A is a finite subset of the index type
f and g map the index type to M
